spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Dashboard Mode: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Neumorphism & Grid Borders. Flat solid cards with 1px subtle border (#E6E2D8). NO heavy drop shadows. Sharp or slightly rounded corners (max rounded-md).

components.button: bg-[#C65D47] text-white hover:bg-[#A64A36] rounded-md transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-sm px-6 py-3
components.card: bg-white border border-[#E6E2D8] rounded-md shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
components.input: border border-[#E6E2D8] bg-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C65D47]/20 focus:border-[#C65D47]
components.badge: uppercase tracking-widest text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-sm bg-[#7A8B76]/10 text-[#7A8B76] font-bold

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hovering on interactive elements translates Y by -2px, slight increase in shadow depth.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward motion (framer-motion).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Checkboxes/Radios have a distinct scale-in animation when selected.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust Spanish UI (hybrid fullstack app) using .js/.jsx files.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Dashboard should focus on clean data visualization: # of topics, total questions, accuracy rate.
Implement file upload feature clearly on the dashboard (PDF to AI questions).
Use standard Shadcn components for complex interactions but strip Vercel-look. Apply our organic earthy color palette.
Provide a 'Modo Examen' (timed) and 'Modo Práctica' (untimed, instant feedback).
Use border-[#E6E2D8] and subtle shadows. Don't use heavy box-shadows. The app should feel like a premium medical journal.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
